content.value: A typical relative refractive index difference for an optical fiber designed for long (11) distance transmission is 1.5%. Estimate the NA and the solid acceptance angle for the fiber when the core index is 1.5. Further, calculate the critical angle at the corecladding interface within the fiber. Assume that the concepts of geometric optics hold for the fiber.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
